LicenseStatus.description: Whether the cited version of a source may be reused, and on what terms.
LicenseStatus.title: LicenseStatus

Lifecycle.description: Where the entry sits between authored and retired.

since.description: ISO date the entry entered this status.
since.title: Since

superseded_by.description: The entries that replace this one, by id. Only a deprecated entry names successors; one split in two names both. Empty when the entry was retired with nothing in its place.
superseded_by.title: Superseded By

Lifecycle.title: Lifecycle

PeerReviewed.description: The review status of the venue a source appeared in.
PeerReviewed.title: PeerReviewed

ReplicationStatus.description: Whether a source replicates other work, or has been replicated.
ReplicationStatus.title: ReplicationStatus

SourceBody.description:
Bibliographic and quality-grade fields.

Open, because the field set is long-tailed: most rows carry the grade
bundle, and the provenance rows also carry retrieval and licensing notes in
no fixed shape.

Only ``kind`` and ``is_internal`` are required, being the two fields every row
carries. The grade fields are optional because some rows lack them.

agent_studied.description: Whose conduct the work observed: the AI system's, the people's, or both. A work that observed only the AI says nothing measured about people.

author_disclosure.description: What the authors disclosed about their own stake.
author_disclosure.title: Author Disclosure

authors.description: Author surnames, in the order the work lists them.
authors.title: Authors

canonical_record.description: Where the authoritative record of this work lives.
canonical_record.title: Canonical Record

conflicts.description: Conflicts of interest bearing on the work, as declared by the authors or apparent from their funding and affiliations.
conflicts.title: Conflicts

design.description: How the study was run, where empirical.
design.title: Design

design_caveat.description: Limitations of the design as run, in the grader's words.
design_caveat.title: Design Caveat

design_fits_own_claims.description: Whether the design supports the claims the work itself makes.
design_fits_own_claims.title: Design Fits Own Claims

grade_reasoning.description: Why the work received that grade.
grade_reasoning.title: Grade Reasoning

identifier.description: External identifier, often a DOI or arXiv id.
identifier.title: Identifier

integrity_flag.description: Post-publication status: none, expression_of_concern, correction_issued, or retracted.
integrity_flag.title: Integrity Flag

is_internal.description: Whether this is one of the project's own artifacts rather than external scholarship. A self-citation is not evidence.
is_internal.title: Is Internal

kind.description: What kind of record this is. `internal_artifact` and `deliberation_record` are the project's own and are never evidence.

license_status.description: Whether the cited version may be reused. Requires `license_terms` and `verified_as_of` when set.

license_terms.description: The license the work states, such as CC BY-NC 3.0, where `license_status` alone does not name it.
license_terms.title: License Terms

n_reported.description: Sample or instance size as the work states it.
n_reported.title: N Reported

other_version.description: The source entry holding another version of the same work, such as the published version of a preprint. Set on both entries, where the two are registered separately because their texts differ and citations quote one or the other.
other_version.title: Other Version

peer_reviewed.description: The review status of the venue. `unknown` means not established, not that the work was unreviewed.

population.description: Who the work studied. `model_only` means no human participants, which bounds what the work can say about people.

preregistered.description: Whether the analysis was registered before data collection.
preregistered.title: Preregistered

replication_status.description: Whether this work replicates another, or has itself been replicated. `none_known` is the default and asserts absence of knowledge, not absence of replication.

source_quality.description: The derived grade. Absent on the legacy provenance rows, which were never graded.

title.description: The work's title, as the work gives it.
title.title: Title

unit_of_analysis.description: The unit this work's data was collected over, such as repeated measures on one person or model responses with no participants. Distinct from an impact edge's `level_of_analysis`, which says whose outcome a claim is about.

verified_as_of.description: When the record was last checked against its source, as YYYY-MM-DD.
verified_as_of.title: Verified As Of

SourceBody.title: SourceBody

SourceKind.description: What kind of record a source row is.
SourceKind.title: SourceKind

SourceQuality.description:
One grade per paper, assigned once on its source entry and reused everywhere.

A property of the paper, not of its bearing on any claim: an A-grade paper
at analogical fit is weak support. Read alongside ``fit``, never instead of it.
SourceQuality.title: SourceQuality

Standing.description:
Evidential standing.

The first six form an ordered evidence scale. The last four sit outside it:
every rung of the scale names a way of observing a person, and these do not.
Standing.title: Standing

StandingBlock.description:
The entry's evidential-strength verdict.

A judgment of what the cited sources actually observed, made by reading them
rather than by counting how citations are filed, and stated in ``basis``.
Entry standing is the minimum over grounding-eligible claims: an entry
asserts the conjunction of its claims, so it is only as observed as its
least observed part.
StandingBlock.title: StandingBlock

StudyLevel.description:
The unit a source's findings are measured over.

Distinct from ``LevelOfAnalysis``, which says whose outcome a claim is about.
This says how the source's data was collected.
StudyLevel.title: StudyLevel

description:
One row in the source registry.

Kept out of the entry models, so loading the catalog's entries means the
authored slots and not these.

aliases.description: Other handles this source is known by.
aliases.title: Aliases

definition.description: What this source is, in one or two sentences.
definition.title: Definition

label.description: Short human name for the source.
label.title: Label

layer.description: Fixed layer. A source is provenance, not observation or judgment.
layer.title: Layer

lifecycle.description: draft, active, or deprecated, where the row records one.

sources.description: Nested source list, on a provenance row that cites one.
sources.title: Sources

standing.description: Present where an older envelope required it. A source has no standing of its own: it is what standing is judged from.

title: Source
